metadata.title: The Last Sugarplum Succession
metadata.premise: When the Confectioner-King of Sucrelle dies without a clear heir, a crushing debt to the Salt Barons threatens to melt the kingdom's sovereignty entirely unless the throne is settled—or the debt escaped—before the treaty deadline strikes midnight.

contentLimits.note: No children are placed in on-screen jeopardy; the succession crisis is handled through adult courtiers and factions only.

beats.title: The Sugarspun Gates
beats.prose: The Candied Citadel of Sucrelle rises before you, its walls hardened caramel gone dull with mourning-frost. Bells of spun sugar toll in a register too sad for their sweetness. The old king is dead, and the city holds its breath.
beats.readAloud: The gates of hardened caramel groan open, and the smell of burnt sugar and old grief rolls out to meet you.

options.label: Slip in through the marzipan market to hear the rumors
Enter by the Cathedral of Confection, where the court will be watching
Take the servants' sugar-tunnels beneath the citadel

beats.title: The King's Last Breath
beats.prose: In the royal larder, King Baumkuchen III lies crystallized on his bier, his body slowly fracturing like brittle toffee. Beside him, a scorched corner of parchment: the Caramel Compact, the treaty that bought his kingdom's sweetness with the Salt Barons' patience—and their salt.

options.label: Examine the King's crystallized remains for cause of death
Question the trembling Steward of Spices
Read the fraying Caramel Compact scroll

beats.title: Court of Crumbs
beats.prose: Duke Marzipane Ganache holds the regency like a man holding a melting candle too close. He speaks smoothly of debts, deadlines, and the necessity of ceding the Crystal Orchard to the Salt Barons to save what remains of Sucrelle.

options.label: Press the Duke on the debt's true cost
Offer to mediate the succession yourselves
Watch how the courtiers flinch around him

beats.title: Princess in the Pantry
beats.prose: You find Princess Nougatine Frost hiding among the flour sacks, still in mourning-sugar, terrified and resolute in equal measure. She is the rightful heir—and utterly unprepared for what the Duke intends.

options.label: Swear to help her claim the throne
Ask what she knows of her father's death
Warn her plainly of the Duke's ambitions

beats.title: Three Paths Through the Sugar
beats.prose: The Salt Barons' deadline draws near. To stop the Duke's sale of the Crystal Orchard, you need leverage—and there are three places it might be found.

options.label: Track the Salt Barons' collection caravan
Search the Archive of Recipes for the treaty's fine print
Stand vigil at the Crystal Orchard's failing wards

beats.title: The Salt Barons' Caravan
beats.prose: Salt-crusted wagons rumble through the frost-cracked orchard road, guarded by hard-eyed mercenaries under a bandit-captain flying the Salt Barons' grey pennant. Their ledger, if you can seize it, may prove the debt was forged.

beats.title: Archive of Recipes
beats.prose: Dust and candied ink fill the Archive of Recipes, where every treaty, tax roll, and marginal joke of the last century is preserved in sugar-glass tablets. Somewhere here is the clause the Duke doesn't want found.

options.label: Decode the marginalia written in candied ink
Cross-reference the treaty against old tax rolls
Bribe the Archivist Mothmallow for the missing page

beats.title: Vigil at the Crystal Orchard
beats.prose: The Crystal Orchard hums with failing magic, its root-crystal unmortgaged and untouched—if you can get past the candied guardians the Duke posted to keep everyone, including the truth, away.

beats.title: Gathered Evidence
beats.prose: Whatever the path, the truth crystallizes at last: the debt was inflated, the treaty's abdication clause was buried, and the King's final breath was sweetened with something that should never have been in his sugar.

options.label: Reveal the Salt Barons' forged ledger
Reveal the treaty's hidden abdication clause
Reveal the Orchard's true, unmortgaged worth

beats.title: The Accusation
beats.prose: Proof in hand, you must choose how to move against the Duke before the Salt Barons' deadline falls and the Crystal Orchard is signed away forever.

options.label: Confront Duke Marzipane publicly in the throne room
Crown Princess Nougatine covertly before the Duke can react
Broker a private deal with the Salt Barons instead

beats.title: Throne Room Clash
beats.prose: The Duke's candied guardians snap to attention as you make your accusation before the court. Steel and sugar-armor gleam. There will be no more diplomacy tonight.

beats.title: The New Sugar Queen
beats.prose: Princess Nougatine Frost ascends the crystallized throne, the forged debt exposed and renegotiated on fairer terms. Sucrelle will be poorer and wiser for a generation, but it will still be sweet, and it will still be free.

beats.title: The Salt Barons' Triumph
beats.prose: The deal is struck. The Crystal Orchard passes into Salt Baron hands, and Sucrelle becomes a bitter vassal state, its sweetness rationed by foreign decree. You saved lives today—but not the kingdom's soul.

beats.title: Bittersweet Regency
beats.prose: The Duke survives, wounded and chastened, to rule on as a bitter regent under a watchful court. No throne changes hands tonight, but the debt is delayed, the Orchard stands, and Sucrelle limps on toward an uncertain, uneasy peace.

victory.description: Fight through to the heart of the Orchard and touch the unmortgaged root-crystal.
